Topic 12.2: Non- locomotive SKILLS

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Non- locomotive SKILLS. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. bending and stretching for body co-ordination
2. have fun as they stretch and bend

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. bending and stretching for body co-ordination
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to bending and stretching for body co-ordination. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. have fun as they stretch and bend
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to have fun as they stretch and bend. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”
